ayahOccurrences.text: فِى ٱلْحَمِيمِ ثُمَّ فِى ٱلنَّارِ يُسْجَرُونَ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: فِى ٱلْحَمِيمِ ثُمَّ فِى ٱلنَّارِ يُسْجَرُونَ

lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: 3rd person masculine plural passive imperfect verb
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: يُسْجَرُونَ is in the derivative form: يُسْجَرون
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
س/ج/ر   s–j–r to fill, to flow, to overflow
; to stretch, to elongate; to set on fire, fuel.

Of this root, 3 forms occur 1 time each in the Qur’an:
يُسْجَرون yusjarūn; سُجِِّرَت sujjirat and مَسْجور masjūr.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
يُسْجَرون yusjarūn [imperf. of pass. v. سُجِر sujira] to be stuffed, to be packed in, to be thrust

(40:72)‏فِي‏ ‏الْحَمِيمِ‏ ‏ثُمَّ‏ ‏فِي‏ ‏النَّارِ‏ ‏يُسْجَرُونَ‏ ‏ into scalding water, and then into the Fire, they are thrust.

entries.label: يُسْجَرون
entries.definitionHtml:
يُسْجَرون yusjarūn [imperf. of pass. v. سُجِر sujira] to be stuffed, to be packed in, to be thrust

(40:72)‏فِي‏ ‏الْحَمِيمِ‏ ‏ثُمَّ‏ ‏فِي‏ ‏النَّارِ‏ ‏يُسْجَرُونَ‏ ‏ into scalding water, and then into the Fire, they are thrust.

entries.label: سُجِّر
entries.definitionHtml:
سُجِّر sujjir [pass. of v. II] to be filled to the point of overflowing; to be set on fire

(81:6) وَإِذَا الْبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتْ when the seas boil over (or, when they are set on fire, or, when they are joined together in one overflowing mass).

entries.label: مَسْجور
entries.definitionHtml:
مَسْجور masjūr [pass. part.] the one which is filled, the one which is set on fire

(52:6) وَالْبَحْرِ الْمَسْجُورِ and by the ocean ever‐filled.
